ecc.note: agents/*.md carry local `effort:` frontmatter per ADR 0009 (per-agent reasoning-effort cost tiers). Unlike `effort:` this is a field upstream DOES ship, with weaker values — so the rule is a VALUE OVERRIDE: never sync a model-value change back to a non-opus tier. scripts/ci/validate-model-routes.js enforces it.
